# Shree Hari Polymers

> PET plastic recycling company in Sahibabad Industrial Area, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh (Delhi NCR), India. We BUY PET scrap in bulk from businesses (PET bottle scrap, PET bottle bales, PET sheet scrap and PET sheet cuttings, PET preform and bottle rejects) and recycle it into recycled PET flakes for fibre, sheet, chemical and monofilament manufacturers.

Key facts:
- Name: Shree Hari Polymers (also "SHP Recycle")
- Type: PET recycler and bulk PET scrap buyer (direct end buyer, not a trader)
- Address: 49/68, Site-4, Sahibabad, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201010, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 97112 26556
- Email: anshagarwal481@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.shprecycle.in/
- GSTIN: 09CBOPA7522G1ZM
- Buys from: scrap dealers, aggregators, sorting centres (MRFs), waste contractors, bottling and preform plants, PET sheet / thermoforming / packaging factories. Bulk and business sellers only, not households.
- Sellers accepted from: Delhi, Noida, Ghaziabad, the rest of Delhi NCR and across India
- Rates: quoted per lot, based on colour, cleanliness, contamination, form and quantity. WhatsApp a photo, the quantity and the location for a rate.
- Does not buy: PVC, PS/HIPS, PP or other non-PET plastics; hazardous or medical waste; small household quantities.
- Sells: recycled PET flakes (clear, light blue, green, mixed; hot and cold washed)
- Languages: English, Hindi
